```diff
+ 'use client'
+ 
+ import {useState, useCallback} from 'react'
+ import {FileUp, File, X} from 'lucide-react'
+ import {Button} from '@/components/ui/button'
+ import {Progress} from '@/components/ui/progress'
+ 
+ interface UploadZoneProps {
+   onUpload: (files: File[]) =&gt; Promise&lt;void&gt;
+   acceptedFileTypes?: string[]
+   maxFileSizeMB?: number
+   maxFiles?: number
+   className?: string
+ }
+ 
+ export function UploadZone({
+   onUpload,
+   acceptedFileTypes = ['.pdf', '.docx', '.txt', '.jpg', '.png'],
+   maxFileSizeMB = 10,
+   maxFiles = 5,
+   className,
+ }: UploadZoneProps) {
+   const [isDragging, setIsDragging] = useState(false)
+   const [selectedFiles, setSelectedFiles] = useState&lt;File[]&gt;([])
+   const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false)
+   const [progress, setProgress] = useState(0)
+   const [error, setError] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null)
+ 
+   const handleDragOver = useCallback((e: React.DragEvent) =&gt; {
+     e.preventDefault()
+     setIsDragging(true)
+   }, [])
+ 
+   const handleDragLeave = useCallback((e: React.DragEvent) =&gt; {
+     e.preventDefault()
+     setIsDragging(false)
+   }, [])
+ 
+   const validateFiles = (files: File[]) =&gt; {
+     // Check number of files
+     if (files.length &gt; maxFiles) {
+       setError(&#96;Maximum ${maxFiles} files allowed&#96;)
+       return false
+     }
+ 
+     // Check file types and sizes
+     for (const file of files) {
+       const fileExtension = &#96;.${file.name.split('.').pop()?.toLowerCase()}&#96;
+       if (!acceptedFileTypes.includes(fileExtension)) {
+         setError(&#96;File type ${fileExtension} not supported&#96;)
+         return false
+       }
+ 
+       if (file.size &gt; maxFileSizeMB * 1024 * 1024) {
+         setError(&#96;File ${file.name} exceeds the maximum size of ${maxFileSizeMB}MB&#96;)
+         return false
+       }
+     }
+ 
+     setError(null)
+     return true
+   }
+ 
+   const handleFileDrop = useCallback(
+     (e: React.DragEvent) =&gt; {
+       e.preventDefault()
+       setIsDragging(false)
+ 
+       const files = Array.from(e.dataTransfer.files)
+       if (validateFiles(files)) {
+         setSelectedFiles(files)
+       }
+     },
+     [maxFiles, acceptedFileTypes, maxFileSizeMB]
+   )
+ 
+   const handleFileSelect = useCallback(
+     (e: React.ChangeEvent&lt;HTMLInputElement&gt;) =&gt; {
+       if (!e.target.files?.length) return
+ 
+       const files = Array.from(e.target.files)
+       if (validateFiles(files)) {
+         setSelectedFiles(files)
+       }
+     },
+     [maxFiles, acceptedFileTypes, maxFileSizeMB]
+   )
+ 
+   const handleRemoveFile = useCallback((index: number) =&gt; {
+     setSelectedFiles((prev) =&gt; prev.filter((_, i) =&gt; i !== index))
+   }, [])
+ 
+   const handleUpload = async () =&gt; {
+     if (selectedFiles.length === 0 || uploading) return
+ 
+     setUploading(true)
+     setProgress(0)
+ 
+     try {
+       // Simulate upload progress
+       const progressInterval = setInterval(() =&gt; {
+         setProgress((prev) =&gt; {
+           const newProgress = prev + 10
+           if (newProgress &gt;= 100) {
+             clearInterval(progressInterval)
+             return 100
+           }
+           return newProgress
+         })
+       }, 300)
+ 
+       await onUpload(selectedFiles)
+ 
+       // Ensure progress reaches 100%
+       setProgress(100)
+       setTimeout(() =&gt; {
+         setSelectedFiles([])
+         setUploading(false)
+       }, 500)
+     } catch (error) {
+       setError('Upload failed. Please try again.')
+       setUploading(false)
+     }
+   }
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;div className={&#96;flex flex-col gap-4 ${className}&#96;}&gt;
+       &lt;div
+         onDragOver={handleDragOver}
+         onDragLeave={handleDragLeave}
+         onDrop={handleFileDrop}
+         className={&#96;
+           flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-8 
+           border-2 border-dashed rounded-lg 
+           transition-colors duration-200 cursor-pointer
+           ${isDragging ? 'border-primary bg-primary/5' : 'border-muted-foreground/25 hover:border-primary/50'}
+         &#96;}&gt;
+         &lt;input
+           type='file'
+           id='file-upload'
+           multiple
+           accept={acceptedFileTypes.join(',')}
+           onChange={handleFileSelect}
+           className='hidden'
+         /&gt;
+         &lt;label htmlFor='file-upload' className='cursor-pointer flex flex-col items-center'&gt;
+           &lt;FileUp className='h-10 w-10 mb-3 text-muted-foreground' /&gt;
+           &lt;p className='text-lg font-medium'&gt;Drag and drop files here&lt;/p&gt;
+           &lt;p className='text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-3'&gt;or click to browse&lt;/p&gt;
+           &lt;p className='text-xs text-muted-foreground text-center max-w-md'&gt;
+             Supports {acceptedFileTypes.join(', ')} up to {maxFileSizeMB}MB each. Maximum {maxFiles}{' '}
+             files.
+           &lt;/p&gt;
+         &lt;/label&gt;
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+       {error &amp;&amp; (
+         &lt;div className='p-3 bg-destructive/10 text-destructive text-sm rounded-md'&gt;{error}&lt;/div&gt;
+       )}
+ 
+       {selectedFiles.length &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; (
+         &lt;div className='mt-4'&gt;
+           &lt;h3 className='text-sm font-medium mb-2'&gt;Selected Files ({selectedFiles.length})&lt;/h3&gt;
+           &lt;div className='space-y-2'&gt;
+             {selectedFiles.map((file, index) =&gt; (
+               &lt;div
+                 key={index}
+                 className='flex items-center justify-between p-3 bg-muted rounded-md'&gt;
+                 &lt;div className='flex items-center'&gt;
+                   &lt;File className='h-4 w-4 mr-2 text-muted-foreground' /&gt;
+                   &lt;span className='text-sm truncate max-w-[250px]'&gt;{file.name}&lt;/span&gt;
+                   &lt;span className='text-xs text-muted-foreground ml-2'&gt;
+                     ({(file.size / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(2)}MB)
+                   &lt;/span&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+                 {!uploading &amp;&amp; (
+                   &lt;Button
+                     variant='ghost'
+                     size='icon'
+                     onClick={() =&gt; handleRemoveFile(index)}
+                     className='h-8 w-8'&gt;
+                     &lt;X className='h-4 w-4' /&gt;
+                   &lt;/Button&gt;
+                 )}
+               &lt;/div&gt;
+             ))}
+           &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+           {uploading ? (
+             &lt;div className='mt-4 space-y-2'&gt;
+               &lt;Progress value={progress} className='h-2 w-full' /&gt;
+               &lt;p className='text-xs text-muted-foreground'&gt;Uploading... {progress}%&lt;/p&gt;
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+           ) : (
+             &lt;Button onClick={handleUpload} className='mt-4 w-full'&gt;
+               Upload {selectedFiles.length} file{selectedFiles.length &gt; 1 ? 's' : ''}
+             &lt;/Button&gt;
+           )}
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+       )}
+     &lt;/div&gt;
+   )
+ }
+
```

```diff
+   Card,

+ } from '@/components/ui/card'

+   DropdownMenu,

+   DropdownMenuTrigger,
+ } from '@/components/ui/dropdown-menu'
+ import {MoreHorizontal} from 'lucide-react'
+ import {Badge} from '@/components/ui/badge'
+ 
+ export interface DocumentCardProps {
+   id: string
+   title: string
+   fileType: string
+   fileSize: number // in bytes
+   uploadDate: Date
+   status: 'processing' | 'analyzed' | 'failed'
+   thumbnail?: string
+   insights?: number
+   onView: (id: string) =&gt; void
+   onDelete: (id: string) =&gt; void
+   className?: string
+ }
+ 
+ export function DocumentCard({
+   id,
+   title,
+   fileType,
+   fileSize,
+   uploadDate,
+   status,
+   thumbnail,
+   insights = 0,
+   onView,
+   onDelete,
+   className,
+ }: DocumentCardProps) {
+   const [isConfirmingDelete, setIsConfirmingDelete] = useState(false)
+ 
+   const getStatusIcon = () =&gt; {
+     switch (status) {
+       case 'processing':
+         return &lt;Clock className='h-4 w-4 text-yellow-500' /&gt;
+       case 'analyzed':
+         return &lt;CheckCircle className='h-4 w-4 text-green-500' /&gt;
+       case 'failed':
+         return &lt;AlertCircle className='h-4 w-4 text-red-500' /&gt;
+       default:
+         return null
+     }
+   }
+ 
+   const getStatusText = () =&gt; {
+     switch (status) {
+       case 'processing':
+         return 'Processing'
+       case 'analyzed':
+         return 'Analyzed'
+       case 'failed':
+         return 'Failed'
+       default:
+         return ''
+     }
+   }
+ 
+   const formatFileSize = (bytes: number) =&gt; {
+     if (bytes &lt; 1024) return &#96;${bytes} B&#96;
+     if (bytes &lt; 1024 * 1024) return &#96;${(bytes / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB&#96;
+     return &#96;${(bytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1)} MB&#96;
+   }
+ 
+   const handleDelete = () =&gt; {
+     if (isConfirmingDelete) {
+       onDelete(id)
+       setIsConfirmingDelete(false)
+     } else {
+       setIsConfirmingDelete(true)
+     }
+   }
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;Card className={cn('overflow-hidden transition-all hover:shadow-md', className)}&gt;
+       &lt;div className='relative'&gt;
+         {thumbnail ? (
+           &lt;div
+             className='h-32 bg-cover bg-center bg-no-repeat'
+             style={{backgroundImage: &#96;url(${thumbnail})&#96;}}
+           /&gt;
+         ) : (
+           &lt;div className='h-32 bg-muted flex items-center justify-center'&gt;
+             &lt;FileText className='h-16 w-16 text-muted-foreground/40' /&gt;
+           &lt;/div&gt;
+         )}
+         &lt;div className='absolute top-2 right-2'&gt;
+           &lt;DropdownMenu&gt;
+             &lt;DropdownMenuTrigger asChild&gt;
+               &lt;Button
+                 variant='ghost'
+                 size='icon'
+                 className='h-8 w-8 bg-background/80 hover:bg-background'&gt;
+                 &lt;MoreHorizontal className='h-4 w-4' /&gt;
+               &lt;/Button&gt;
+             &lt;/DropdownMenuTrigger&gt;
+             &lt;DropdownMenuContent align='end'&gt;
+               &lt;DropdownMenuItem onClick={() =&gt; onView(id)}&gt;View Document&lt;/DropdownMenuItem&gt;
+               &lt;DropdownMenuItem
+                 onClick={handleDelete}
+                 className='text-destructive focus:text-destructive'&gt;
+                 {isConfirmingDelete ? 'Confirm Delete' : 'Delete'}
+               &lt;/DropdownMenuItem&gt;
+             &lt;/DropdownMenuContent&gt;
+           &lt;/DropdownMenu&gt;
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+       &lt;CardHeader className='p-4 pb-2'&gt;
+         &lt;div className='flex justify-between items-start'&gt;
+           &lt;CardTitle className='text-base line-clamp-1'&gt;{title}&lt;/CardTitle&gt;
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+         &lt;CardDescription className='flex items-center gap-1 mt-1'&gt;
+           &lt;Badge variant='outline' className='text-xs px-1 py-0'&gt;
+             {fileType.toUpperCase()}
+           &lt;/Badge&gt;
+           &lt;span className='text-xs'&gt;{formatFileSize(fileSize)}&lt;/span&gt;
+         &lt;/CardDescription&gt;
+       &lt;/CardHeader&gt;

+       &lt;CardContent className='p-4 pt-0 pb-2'&gt;
```

```diff
+ 'use client'
+ 
+ import {useState} from 'react'
+ import {Grid, List, SortAsc, SortDesc} from 'lucide-react'
+ import {DocumentCard, type DocumentCardProps} from './document-card'
+ import {Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue} from '@/components/ui/select'
+ import {Button} from '@/components/ui/button'
+ import {Toggle} from '@/components/ui/toggle'
+ 
+ interface DocumentsListProps {
+   documents: Omit&lt;DocumentCardProps, 'onView' | 'onDelete'&gt;[]
+   onViewDocument: (id: string) =&gt; void
+   onDeleteDocument: (id: string) =&gt; void
+   loading?: boolean
+   emptyState?: React.ReactNode
+   className?: string
+ }
+ 
+ type SortField = 'title' | 'uploadDate' | 'fileSize'
+ type SortOrder = 'asc' | 'desc'
+ type ViewMode = 'grid' | 'list'
+ 
+ export function DocumentsList({
+   documents,
+   onViewDocument,
+   onDeleteDocument,
+   loading = false,
+   emptyState,
+   className,
+ }: DocumentsListProps) {
+   const [sortField, setSortField] = useState&lt;SortField&gt;('uploadDate')
+   const [sortOrder, setSortOrder] = useState&lt;SortOrder&gt;('desc')
+   const [viewMode, setViewMode] = useState&lt;ViewMode&gt;('grid')
+ 
+   const sortedDocuments = [...documents].sort((a, b) =&gt; {
+     if (sortField === 'title') {
+       return sortOrder === 'asc' ? a.title.localeCompare(b.title) : b.title.localeCompare(a.title)
+     }
+     if (sortField === 'uploadDate') {
+       return sortOrder === 'asc'
+         ? a.uploadDate.getTime() - b.uploadDate.getTime()
+         : b.uploadDate.getTime() - a.uploadDate.getTime()
+     }
+     if (sortField === 'fileSize') {
+       return sortOrder === 'asc' ? a.fileSize - b.fileSize : b.fileSize - a.fileSize
+     }
+     return 0
+   })
+ 
+   const toggleSortOrder = () =&gt; {
+     setSortOrder(sortOrder === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc')
+   }
+ 
+   if (loading) {
+     return (
+       &lt;div className='flex justify-center items-center py-12'&gt;
+         &lt;div className='animate-spin rounded-full h-8 w-8 border-b-2 border-primary'&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+     )
+   }
+ 
+   if (documents.length === 0 &amp;&amp; emptyState) {
```

```diff
+ import {CheckCircle, XCircle, AlertTriangle, Clock} from 'lucide-react'
+ import {Progress} from '@/components/ui/progress'
+ import {cn} from '@/lib/utils'
+ 
+ interface DocumentStatusProps {
+   status: 'processing' | 'analyzed' | 'failed'
+   progress?: number // 0-100
+   errorMessage?: string
+   className?: string
+ }
+ 
+ export function DocumentStatus({
+   status,
+   progress = 0,
+   errorMessage,
+   className,
+ }: DocumentStatusProps) {
+   const getStatusIcon = () =&gt; {
+     switch (status) {
+       case 'processing':
+         return &lt;Clock className='h-10 w-10 text-yellow-500 animate-pulse' /&gt;
+       case 'analyzed':
+         return &lt;CheckCircle className='h-10 w-10 text-green-500' /&gt;
+       case 'failed':
+         return &lt;XCircle className='h-10 w-10 text-red-500' /&gt;
+       default:
+         return null
+     }
+   }
+ 
+   const getStatusTitle = () =&gt; {
+     switch (status) {
+       case 'processing':
+         return 'Processing Document'
+       case 'analyzed':
+         return 'Analysis Complete'
+       case 'failed':
+         return 'Processing Failed'
+       default:
+         return ''
+     }
+   }
+ 
+   const getStatusDescription = () =&gt; {
+     switch (status) {
+       case 'processing':
+         return 'We are analyzing your document. This may take a few minutes depending on the size of the document.'
+       case 'analyzed':
+         return 'Your document has been successfully analyzed. AI insights are now available.'
+       case 'failed':
+         return (
+           errorMessage ||
+           'We encountered an error processing your document. Please try again or contact support.'
+         )
+       default:
+         return ''
+     }
+   }
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;div className={cn('flex flex-col items-center text-center max-w-md', className)}&gt;
+       &lt;div className='mb-4'&gt;{getStatusIcon()}&lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+       &lt;h3 className='text-lg font-semibold mb-2'&gt;{getStatusTitle()}&lt;/h3&gt;
+ 
+       &lt;p className='text-muted-foreground mb-4 text-sm'&gt;{getStatusDescription()}&lt;/p&gt;
+ 
+       {status === 'processing' &amp;&amp; (
+         &lt;div className='w-full max-w-xs'&gt;
+           &lt;Progress value={progress} className='h-2 mb-2' /&gt;
+           &lt;p className='text-xs text-muted-foreground'&gt;{progress}% complete&lt;/p&gt;
+         &lt;/div&gt;

+ 
+       {status === 'failed' &amp;&amp; (

+           &lt;AlertTriangle className='h-4 w-4 mr-1 text-amber-500' /&gt;
+           &lt;span&gt;If this problem persists, please try uploading the document again&lt;/span&gt;
```

```diff
+ 'use client'
+ 
+ import {useState} from 'react'
+ import {FileText, FileQuestion, Tag, ListChecks, BookOpen, Copy, Check} from 'lucide-react'
+ import {
+   Accordion,
+   AccordionContent,
+   AccordionItem,
+   AccordionTrigger,
+ } from '@/components/ui/accordion'
+ import {Button} from '@/components/ui/button'
+ import {Badge} from '@/components/ui/badge'
+ import type {DocumentInsight} from './document'
+ 
+ interface AIInsightsProps {
+   insights: DocumentInsight[]
+   documentId: string
+   className?: string
+ }
+ 
+ export function AIInsights({insights, documentId, className}: AIInsightsProps) {
+   const [copiedInsightId, setCopiedInsightId] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null)
+ 
+   // Group insights by type
+   const insightsByType = insights.reduce&lt;Record&lt;string, DocumentInsight[]&gt;&gt;((acc, insight) =&gt; {
+     if (!acc[insight.type]) {
+       acc[insight.type] = []
+     }
+     acc[insight.type].push(insight)
+     return acc
+   }, {})
+ 
+   const getTypeLabel = (type: string): string =&gt; {
+     switch (type) {
+       case 'summary':
+         return 'Document Summary'
+       case 'entity':
+         return 'Entities'
+       case 'key_point':
+         return 'Key Points'
+       case 'question':
+         return 'Questions &amp; Answers'
+       case 'topic':
+         return 'Topics'
+       default:
+         return type.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + type.slice(1).replace('_', ' ')
+     }
+   }
+ 
+   const getTypeIcon = (type: string) =&gt; {
+     switch (type) {
+       case 'summary':
+         return &lt;BookOpen className='h-4 w-4' /&gt;
+       case 'entity':
+         return &lt;Tag className='h-4 w-4' /&gt;
+       case 'key_point':
+         return &lt;ListChecks className='h-4 w-4' /&gt;
+       case 'question':
+         return &lt;FileQuestion className='h-4 w-4' /&gt;
+       case 'topic':
+         return &lt;FileText className='h-4 w-4' /&gt;
+       default:
+         return &lt;FileText className='h-4 w-4' /&gt;
+     }
+   }
+ 
+   const handleCopyInsight = (insight: DocumentInsight) =&gt; {
+     navigator.clipboard.writeText(insight.content)
+     setCopiedInsightId(insight.id)
+     setTimeout(() =&gt; setCopiedInsightId(null), 2000)
+   }
+ 
+   const getConfidenceColor = (confidence: number) =&gt; {
+     if (confidence &gt;= 0.8) return 'bg-green-500/10 text-green-700 dark:text-green-400'
+     if (confidence &gt;= 0.5) return 'bg-yellow-500/10 text-yellow-700 dark:text-yellow-400'
+     return 'bg-red-500/10 text-red-700 dark:text-red-400'
+   }
+ 
+   if (insights.length === 0) {
+     return (
+       &lt;div className='flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-full p-8 text-center'&gt;
+         &lt;FileText className='h-12 w-12 text-muted-foreground mb-4' /&gt;
+         &lt;h3 className='text-lg font-semibold'&gt;No Insights Available&lt;/h3&gt;
+         &lt;p className='text-muted-foreground max-w-md'&gt;
+           This document hasn't been analyzed yet or no insights were found. Check back later or try
+           processing the document again.
+         &lt;/p&gt;
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+     )
+   }
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;div className={className}&gt;
+       {Object.entries(insightsByType).map(([type, typeInsights]) =&gt; (
+         &lt;div key={type} className='mb-6'&gt;
+           &lt;div className='flex items-center gap-2 mb-2'&gt;
+             {getTypeIcon(type)}
+             &lt;h3 className='text-lg font-medium'&gt;{getTypeLabel(type)}&lt;/h3&gt;
+             &lt;Badge variant='outline' className='ml-auto'&gt;
+               {typeInsights.length}
+             &lt;/Badge&gt;
+           &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+           &lt;Accordion type='multiple' className='bg-muted/30 rounded-md'&gt;
+             {typeInsights.map((insight) =&gt; (
+               &lt;AccordionItem key={insight.id} value={insight.id} className='border-b last:border-0'&gt;
+                 &lt;AccordionTrigger className='px-4 py-2 text-sm hover:no-underline hover:bg-muted/50'&gt;
+                   &lt;span className='font-medium'&gt;{insight.title}&lt;/span&gt;
+                 &lt;/AccordionTrigger&gt;
+                 &lt;AccordionContent className='px-4 pb-3 pt-1'&gt;
+                   &lt;div className='flex justify-between items-start mb-2'&gt;
+                     &lt;Badge
+                       variant='secondary'
+                       className={&#96;text-xs ${getConfidenceColor(insight.confidence)}&#96;}&gt;
+                       {Math.round(insight.confidence * 100)}% confidence
+                     &lt;/Badge&gt;
+                     &lt;Button
+                       variant='ghost'
+                       size='sm'
+                       className='h-7 px-2'
+                       onClick={() =&gt; handleCopyInsight(insight)}&gt;
+                       {copiedInsightId === insight.id ? (
+                         &lt;&gt;
+                           &lt;Check className='h-3.5 w-3.5 mr-1' /&gt;
+                           &lt;span className='text-xs'&gt;Copied&lt;/span&gt;
+                         &lt;/&gt;
+                       ) : (
+                         &lt;&gt;
+                           &lt;Copy className='h-3.5 w-3.5 mr-1' /&gt;
+                           &lt;span className='text-xs'&gt;Copy&lt;/span&gt;
+                         &lt;/&gt;
+                       )}
+                     &lt;/Button&gt;
+                   &lt;/div&gt;
+                   &lt;div className='text-sm whitespace-pre-line'&gt;{insight.content}&lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;/AccordionContent&gt;
+               &lt;/AccordionItem&gt;
+             ))}
+           &lt;/Accordion&gt;
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+       ))}
+     &lt;/div&gt;
+   )
+ }
+ 
```
